name: Zhizn Bez Leta
source:
This is the biography of Semyon Persunov, who, contrary to the game's traditions, did not end up in the Sovyonok camp.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1677333568]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是谢苗·佩尔苏诺夫 (Semyon Persunov) 的传记，与游戏传统相反，他最终没有加入索维诺克阵营。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1677333568]Steam[/url]]
